toolInput.title: Learning to Structure Scientific Documents
toolInput.abstract: We present a pipeline that converts scientific PDFs into structured JSON by combining layout-aware OCR with a large language model.

sections.heading: 1 Introduction
sections.text: Scientific papers are published as PDF, which keeps the layout but loses the structure.
